answer: Work-slot deposit bond: one slot per agent in a dune grove, 70 each, bound to one key in the grove ledger. A key-signed work thread files a fresh hash per epoch. A dune auditor replays it against the public dune table within 3%; an idle, copied, or second thread burns the bond. First 30, k-th 30+6(k-1), 1000th 6,024; 1,000 fakes pay 3,027,000, lock 70,000, for 40,000 reward. Rented thread fails, hash bearing another key; the honest pay 30 once.
